verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
About what do they question one another?
[✲]About the great Event,
Concerning which they differ.
Nay, soon they will come to know.
w: soon they will come to know

verses.en: Nay, We say it again, they will soon come to know.
w: they will soon come to know

verses.en: Have We not made the earth a bed,
And the mountains as pegs?
And We have created you in pairs,
And We have made your sleep for rest,
And We have made the night as a covering,
[✲]And We have made the day for the activities of life.
And We have built over you seven strong heavens;
And We have made the sun a bright lamp.
And We send down from the dripping clouds water pouring forth abundantly,
That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation,
And gardens of luxuriant growth.
Surely, the Day of Decision has an appointed time:

verses.ar: یَّوۡمَ یُنۡفَخُ فِی الصُّوۡرِ فَتَاۡتُوۡنَ اَفۡوَاجًا ﴿ۙ۱۹﴾
verses.en: [✲]The day when the trumpet will be blown; and you will come in large groups;
And the heaven shall be opened and shall become all doors;
And the mountains shall be made to move and shall become as if they were a mirage.
w: and shall be made to move

verses.en: Surely Hell lies in ambush,
A home for the rebellious,
Who will tarry therein for ages.

verses.ar: لَا یَذُوۡقُوۡنَ فِیۡہَا بَرۡدًا وَّلَا شَرَابًا ﴿ۙ۲۵﴾
verses.en: [✲]They will taste therein neither sleep nor drink,
[✲]Save boiling water and a stinking fluid —
[✲]A meet requital.
Verily, they feared not the reckoning,
And rejected Our Signs totally.
And every thing have We recorded in a Book.
‘Taste ye therefore the punishment: We will give you no increase except in torment.’
Verily, for the righteous is a triumph:
Walled gardens and grape-vines,
And young maidens of equal age,
And overflowing cups.

verses.ar: لَا یَسۡمَعُوۡنَ فِیۡہَا لَغۡوًا وَّلَا کِذّٰبًا ﴿ۚ۳۶﴾
verses.en: Therein they will hear no idle talk nor lying:
A recompense from thy Lord — a gift in proportion to their works —

verses.ar: رَّبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَیۡنَہُمَا الرَّحۡمٰنِ لَا یَمۡلِکُوۡنَ مِنۡہُ خِطَابًا ﴿ۚ۳۸﴾
verses.en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the Gracious. [✲]They shall not have the power to address Him.

verses.ar: یَوۡمَ یَقُوۡمُ الرُّوۡحُ وَالۡمَلٰٓئِکَۃُ صَفًّا ؕ٭ۙ لَّا یَتَکَلَّمُوۡنَ اِلَّا مَنۡ اَذِنَ لَہُ الرَّحۡمٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا ﴿۳۹﴾
verses.en: On the day when the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they shall not speak, except he whom the Gracious God will permit and who will speak only what is right.
w: and who will speak only what

verses.ar: ذٰلِکَ الۡیَوۡمُ الۡحَقُّ ۚ فَمَنۡ شَآءَ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰی رَبِّہٖ مَاٰبًا ﴿۴۰﴾
verses.en: That day is sure to come. So let him, who will, seek recourse unto his Lord.

verses.ar: اِنَّاۤ اَنۡذَرۡنٰکُمۡ عَذَابًا قَرِیۡبًا ۬ۚۖ یَّوۡمَ یَنۡظُرُ الۡمَرۡءُ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ یَدٰہُ وَیَقُوۡلُ الۡکٰفِرُ یٰلَیۡتَنِیۡ کُنۡتُ تُرٰبًا ﴿٪۴۱﴾
verses.en: Verily, We have warned you of a punishment which is near at hand: a day when man will see what his hands have sent on before, and the disbeliever will say, ‘Would that I were mere dust!’
